import json,os,pathlib,pwd,subprocess
src=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/Vivoapk/source')

env={**os.environ,'GIT_PAGER':'cat','PAGER':'cat','GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT':'0'}
def git(args,t=15):
 p=subprocess.run(prefix+['git','--no-pager','-C',str(src)]+args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=t,env=env,check=True)
 return p.stdout.strip()

git(['fetch','--no-tags','--no-write-fetch-head','--refmap=','--no-recurse-submodules','origin',new],45)

git(['merge-base','--is-ancestor',old,new])
